problem.problem:
Bob is quiet. Bob is white. Dave is kind. Dave is red. Dave is young. Fiona is red. Fiona is round. Gary is quiet. Gary is red. Gary is round. White things are round. If something is kind and white then it is green. All young things are kind. All round things are young. All quiet, kind things are white. Quiet, green things are red. Young, quiet things are kind. All quiet, red things are kind. If Gary is young then Gary is round.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Gary is not quiet.
raw_logic_programs:
Predicates:
Quiet($x, bool) ::: Is x quiet?
White($x, bool) ::: Is x white?
Kind($x, bool) ::: Is x kind?
Red($x, bool) ::: Is x red?
Young($x, bool) ::: Is x young?
Round($x, bool) ::: Is x round?
Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?

Facts:
Quiet(Bob, True) ::: Bob is quiet.
White(Bob, True) ::: Bob is white.
Kind(Dave, True) ::: Dave is kind.
Red(Dave, True) ::: Dave is red.
Young(Dave, True) ::: Dave is young.
Red(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is red.
Round(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is round.
Quiet(Gary, True) ::: Gary is quiet.
Red(Gary, True) ::: Gary is red.
Round(Gary, True) ::: Gary is round.

Rules:
White($x, True) >>> Round($x, True) ::: White things are round.
Kind($x, True) && White($x, True) >>> Green($x, True) ::: If something is kind and white then it is green.
Young($x, True) >>> Kind($x, True) ::: All young things are kind.
Round($x, True) >>> Young($x, True) ::: All round things are young.
Quiet($x, True) && Kind($x, True) >>> White($x, True) ::: All quiet, kind things are white.
Quiet($x, True) && Green($x, True) >>> Red($x, True) ::: Quiet, green things are red.
Young($x, True) && Quiet($x, True) >>> Kind($x, True) ::: Young, quiet things are kind.
Quiet($x, True) && Red($x, True) >>> Kind($x, True) ::: All quiet, red things are kind.
Young(Gary, True) >>> Round(Gary, True) ::: If Gary is young then Gary is round.

Query:
Quiet(Gary, False) ::: Gary is not quiet.
